page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, offering 32 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, place the instance in the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including Passmark CPU and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently achieve average performance within the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average throughput, reaching 98.48 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads.

Due to its older Intel Xeon Broadwell architecture, the instance exhibits a tradeoff between single-threaded speed and multi-threaded density. While single-core tasks are slow, the 32 dedicated cores provide stable, predictable multi-threaded performance. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this hardware profile offers a dense allocation of dedicated resources suitable for workloads that do not require the latest instruction sets or high single-core burst speeds. Recommended workloads include multi-threaded database operations, Redis caching, static web serving, and moderate parallel processing tasks.
